title: Monte Carlo Probability Workbench
summary: Model a practical problem, check its assumptions and compare decisions with Monte Carlo simulation. Groups 1 and 2 of 10: the 10 discrete and 13 continuous laws, each with a behaviour experiment and three workflows of its own; independent sampling, the inverse transform and rejection sampling; stratification, antithetic variables, control variates and common random numbers, each with a failure example; a Philox4x32-10 generator with named streams and workers, exact or quadrature reference values, claim tags for every result, and versioned model and run records. Three public-domain datasets: Bortkiewicz's horse kicks, Rutherford and Geiger's alpha particles and Weldon's dice. Works offline: MathJax 4.1.3 and Fira Math are embedded.
